cohort: The study enrolled 190 antenatal women beyond 28 weeks of gestation, divided into 95 with a previous spontaneous abortion (cases) and 95 with a previous full-term delivery (controls).
finding: Adverse pregnancy outcomes were significantly higher among women with a previous abortion compared to controls, with increased incidence of preterm delivery, low birth weight, preeclampsia, intrauterine growth restriction, and NICU admissions.
